from collections import Counter

def transform(grid):
    # The solid separator splits two same-sized panels. The left panel masks
    # marked cells in the right panel; surviving right-side anomalies become 3.
    width=len(grid[0])
    sep=next(i for i in range(width) if len({row[i] for row in grid})==1 and i>0)
    left=[row[:sep] for row in grid]
    right=[row[sep+1:] for row in grid]
    if len(left[0]) != len(right[0]):
        raise ValueError('panels must have equal width')
    left_bg=Counter(v for row in left for v in row).most_common(1)[0][0]
    right_bg=Counter(v for row in right for v in row).most_common(1)[0][0]
    return [[3 if rv != right_bg and lv == left_bg else 1 for lv,rv in zip(lrow,rrow)] for lrow,rrow in zip(left,right)]
